findings.cause: Outer runSemanticBoundary timeout kills direct worker only; grammar Node child has no parent-death or independently supervised process-tree cleanup. Worker-owned spawnSync watchdog dies with worker.
findings.observation: SIGSTOP exact own --check child at567ms under900ms budget; worker killed, UNKNOWN returned~944ms; child remains T(stopped) after extra1250ms with PPid1. Critic SIGKILL cleanup.
findings.impact: No false PROVEN observed. A stalled or externally stopped grammar parser can outlive declared analysis deadline and parent return, leak processes/resources and escape the worker kill boundary.
findings.recommendation: Independent parent ownership of the complete private process tree/group or equivalent death supervision; bounded cleanup on timeout/error/interruption, never kill unrelated processes; preserve UNKNOWN/zero proofs.
